```{r setup, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
draw_label_theme <- function(label, theme = NULL, element = "text", ...) {
  if (is.null(theme)) {
    theme <- ggplot2::theme_get()
  }
  if (!element %in% names(theme)) {
    stop("Element must be a valid ggplot theme element name")
  }

  elements <- ggplot2::calc_element(element, theme)

  cowplot::draw_label(label, 
                      fontfamily = elements$family,
                      fontface = elements$face,
                      colour = elements$color,
                      size = elements$size,
                      ...
  )
}
```

# Figure S6: expression level of markers as boxplots
```{r cite-seq based celtype validation with key markers, include=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.align='center', fig.height=9, fig.width=16}
#import the 82k seurat object

temp<- tempfile(fileext = ".rds")
dl <- drive_download(
as_id("1Z1gGEfNz7R-qYXizY7Sg6mzJxJkEm6Ti"), path = temp, overwrite = TRUE)
refmapped.all <- readRDS(file = dl$local_path)

rownames(refmapped.all[["ADT"]])

# create a list of markers
lin_markers<-c("","CD19.1", "CD3", "CD4.1","CD8a", "CD14.1", "CD16", "CD56-NCAM", "CD11c")

refmapped.all_adt<-subset(refmapped.all, subset=assay=="CITE-seq")
DefaultAssay(refmapped.all_adt)<-"ADT"

# keep only relevant cell types
refmapped.all_adt<-subset(refmapped.all_adt, subset = predicted.celltype.l2 %in% c("B intermediate",
                             "B memory",
                             "B naive",
                             "Plasmablast",
                             "CD14 Mono",
                             "CD16 Mono",
                             "CD4 Naive",
                             "CD4 TCM",
                             "CD8 Naive",
                             "CD8 TCM",
                             "CD8 TEM",
                             "cDC1",
                             "cDC2",
                             "pDC",
                             "gdT",
                             "ILC",
                            "MAIT",
                           "NK",
                           "NK_CD56bright",
                           "Treg"
                           ))
#VlnPlot(refmapped.all_adt, features = lin_markers, group.by = "predicted.celltype.l2")->vln_adt
#vln_adt<-vln_adt+
#  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.4, color = "grey30", outlier.shape = NA) +
 # stat_compare_means(label = "p", method = "wilcox.test", vjust = 1)

# manual plotting
linmarkers_ad.df<-FetchData(refmapped.all_adt,c(lin_markers,"subject_id", "predicted.celltype.l2", "phenotype"))
linmarkers_ad.df<-linmarkers_ad.df%>%
  pivot_longer(., !c("predicted.celltype.l2", "subject_id", "phenotype")) %>%
  group_by(predicted.celltype.l2, subject_id, name, phenotype) %>%
  summarise(n = median(value))

celltype_levels<-c( "CD14 Mono",
                    "CD16 Mono",
                    "cDC1",
                             "cDC2",
                             "pDC",
                     "NK",
                           "NK_CD56bright",
                    "B naive",
                   "B intermediate",
                   "B memory",
                    "Plasmablast",
                    "CD4 Naive",
                             "CD4 TCM",
                    "Treg",
                             "CD8 Naive",
                             "CD8 TCM",
                             "CD8 TEM",
                   "gdT",
                             "ILC",
                            "MAIT"
                   )

# reanme markers
linmarkers_ad.df$name <-gsub("CD14.1","CD14", linmarkers_ad.df$name)
linmarkers_ad.df$name <-gsub("CD19.1","CD19", linmarkers_ad.df$name)
linmarkers_ad.df$name <-gsub("CD4.1","CD4", linmarkers_ad.df$name)
linmarkers_ad.df$name <-gsub("CD56-NCAM","CD56", linmarkers_ad.df$name)
linmarkers_ad.df$name <-gsub("CD8a","CD8", linmarkers_ad.df$name)

manual_adt_violin<-ggplot(linmarkers_ad.df, aes(x=factor(predicted.celltype.l2, levels = celltype_levels), y=n, #fill = factor(phenotype, levels = c("Aparasitemic", "Parasitemic")), 
                                                color = phenotype)) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(), size=1, alpha=0.65) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.4, color = "grey30", outlier.shape = NA) +
  #stat_compare_means(label = "p", 
  #                   comparisons = my_comps, method = "wilcox.test", vjust = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c( "Aparasitemic"="#3B9AB2",  "Parasitemic"="#F21A00" )) +
  xlab("transcriptionally defined subset") +
  ylab("surace expression by antibody-derived tags (CITE-seq)") +
  facet_wrap(~name, scales = "free", nrow=2) +
  ylim(0, 500)+
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size=8),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=8, angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1),
        axis.title.y  = element_text(size=16),
        axis.title.x  = element_text(size=16),
        strip.text = element_text(size= 14),
        legend.position = "top",
        legend.text = element_text(size= 16),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_rect(colour = "darkgrey", fill=NA, size=1),
        plot.margin=unit(c(0.01,0.01,0.01,0.01), "null"))+
  grids(linetype = "dashed")+
  ylim(0,80)


manual_adt_violin
```
